title: Remote resource URLs assigned through DOM mutation APIs bypassed the registry gate

reproduction.beforeFix: All three DOM mutation forms returned pass even though they request a remote image.
reproduction.afterFix: Remote resource URLs written through setAttribute, Reflect.set, and Object.defineProperty fail the source-isolation gate.

rootCause: Remote request scanning covered static markup and direct property assignments but not the DOM APIs that assign resource-bearing attributes.
remediation: Resolve element tags, resource attributes, descriptor values, and static URLs for DOM mutation calls; reject remote requests without running source.

validation.redBeforeFix: pnpm exec vitest run packages/registry-gate/src/__tests__/registry-gate.test.ts -t "remote resource URLs assigned through DOM mutation APIs"
validation.redBeforeFixResult: failed as expected: remote img src mutations returned pass
validation.resourceScan: All 324 catalogue resources pass source isolation
